currentTwLabel: 不動產、廠房及設備（機器設備）

note.zh-TW: 故事裡的電腦設備依教材歸入機器設備；現行報表把它放在不動產、廠房及設備之下，模板位置顯示扣除累計折舊後的淨額。
note.en: The computers in the story are classed as machinery and equipment, following the course; current statements place them under property, plant and equipment, and the template position shows the amount net of accumulated depreciation.

definition.zh-TW: 公司買來長期使用、用來做生意的設備。它以成本入帳，之後每年提列折舊，報表上顯示扣掉累計折舊後的淨額。
definition.en: Equipment bought for long-term use in the business. It is recorded at cost, depreciated each year and shown net of accumulated depreciation on the statement.
